commands: export DB_HOST=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /anot/prod/DB_HOST --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text)
export DB_USER=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /anot/prod/DB_USER --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text)
export DB_NAME=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /anot/prod/DB_NAME --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text)
export DB_PORT=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /anot/prod/DB_PORT --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text)
export DB_PASSWORD=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /anot/prod/DB_PASSWORD --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text)
const ssl = fs.existsSync(caPath) ? { ca: fs.readFileSync(caPath, 'utf8'), rejectUnauthorized: true } : { rejectUnauthorized: true };
const pool = new Pool({ host: process.env.DB_HOST, port: Number(process.env.DB_PORT)||5432, database: process.env.DB_NAME, user: process.env.DB_USER, password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD, ssl });

const r = await pool.query(`SELECT id, email, role, mfa_enabled, (mfa_secret IS NOT NULL) AS has_plain_secret, (mfa_secret_encrypted IS NOT NULL AND mfa_secret_encrypted <> '') AS has_enc_secret, phi_training_acknowledged, phi_training_version, force_password_change FROM users WHERE email ILIKE '%celina%' OR name ILIKE '%celina%'`);
})().catch(async (e) => { console.error(e); try { await pool.end(); } catch {} process.exit(1); });
